Traditional Huè cuisine. Exceptional value for money.
Aug 2026 • Family
We ate at Huè for 2 consecutive nights. Recommended by the LP guide, it fully met our expectations. Truly exceptional traditional cuisine.
Over 2 nights, my family and I tried more than half the menu and I must say that everything was delicious, well-plated, and tasty. From Ban Beo to traditional Huè White rose. Each course is served with its own accompanying sauce. Unbeatable value for money. If we had had a little more time, I would definitely have taken the Cooking Class with Madam Thu.

Great cooking class! Highly recommended!
Jul 2026 • Friends
We chose the cooking class without the market visit, since we were at the Imperial Citadel in the morning. We were welcomed very warmly with a herbal foot bath and a cold drink. Alicia, the chef, explained the three dishes very well to us, we diligently chopped, rolled, and folded along, and were thrilled with our results. The cooking class took place outside and what we really liked was that there were only four of us! Truly a highlight, you can also have very delicious meals there outside of the cooking class.
